Those responses are easily, if maybe not satisfactorily, addressed:

1. The point is "after initial selection but before MTF Basic School, during a lull between roll call and the time allocated to fill out the new MTF operative's formal assignment paperwork."

2. Nope! Although you could argue that it acts as a prequel to the Theta-90 tales, I suppose. But it's not really supposed to Go Anywhere, writ large. I like that kind of vignette and will write it regardless of downvotes (assuming the articles survive, of course).

I'm not sure if I'm just really sleepy right now and it's clouding my judgement, but this one didn't do much for me. Perhaps my disappointment stems from I really like the idea, but feel it didn't go quite far enough. I like the idea of an MTF pre-assignment meeting, but I don't feel like I gained any intimate knowledge of its inner workings, the various task forces, or the people.

I guess my problem its that it one was step short of something truly great. And I feel like i'm about to pass out at my keyboard. I like it, it's crafted well, but it could have been so much more. Tenuous upvote.

item.content:encoded:
Okay! This is a thing I've been thinking about doing for a while. There are some awesome Orientations for scientist and regular Agents (thanks to DrMann for okaying the callback, by the way), but there wasn't one for new Mobile Task Force operatives in particular, specially given the current site canon of them being something of an elite group. Of course, in real life, it's usually not just a neat little orientation meeting, so I had them do all their paperwork and admin stuff off-camera after the break.

Edit: Didn't wanna say it in the text, but just in case anyone's curious, Rabbi Ben-David is there for two reasons: he's taking over the "welcome wagon" appointment next month, and he wanted to get his eyes on Aziz ASAP to see what he'd be working with.

Edit 2: This doesn't link back to the MTF Theta-90 Hub Page because it's not really a Theta-90 tale, as such. But, obviously, Dimaccio and Weiss are the same people from the Theta-90 tales. I've since changed the title to make this more obvious.
